detailed_description: BIC/SWIFT Lookup tool validates and provides information about Bank Identifier Codes (BIC) used for international wire transfers. Enter a BIC code to verify its format and get details about the bank, country, and branch. Essential for ensuring accurate international payments.
usage_steps: Enter a BIC/SWIFT code in the input field
Click Look Up to validate and get bank information
View the parsed code structure (bank, country, location, branch)
Check bank details if available in the database
Use sample codes to explore different banks
usage_examples: Verify BIC codes before making international transfers
Look up bank information from SWIFT codes
Validate payment details for cross-border transactions
